raw_cells:
UNLEASHING POTENTIAL:
OUR TALENT STRATEGY
We focused on enhancing our talent strategy, organisational structure,
and culture to ensure we remain competitive and future-ready. Our efforts
included comprehensive audits, new operating models, and leadership
initiatives, all designed to foster a high-performance, digitally-enabled
workplace.
More information below on how we prioritised these efforts through
programmes and initiatives.
High-level summary of what we prioritised
• Tech Talent Development: We undertook a tech skills audit,
identified critical technology skills, and implemented frameworks
for managing on-demand tech talent. Our goal was to certify
100% of staff in 2+1 tech courses and reduce tech talent attrition
to below 5%.
• Organisational Design: We implemented new operating
models and designed a fit-for-future organisational structure.
This involved strategic manpower planning and monitoring
effectiveness metrics.
• Cultural Advancement: We advanced the Spirit of Safaricom
by embedding leadership shifts, fostering psychological safety, and
strengthening performance management through 360˚ feedback.
• Digital Employee Experience: We aimed to simplify and
digitalise employee journeys, roll out a competitive reward
framework, and enhance our workplace with technology.
• Agile Implementation: We assessed and advanced our Agile
maturity, implemented Agile training, and linked performance to
mission through a new Agile performance tool.
